wholePhysicalScope: Native footprint, USDA aerial and the National Historic Landmark description. Mapped main shell and two rear wings were frozen before detailed facade authoring.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the open polygonal porch, Queen Anne roof and rear wings.
limitations: The working roof ridge positions, side gables and trim ornament are proportional interpretations where the public-domain overhead view is occluded by trees. Interior spaces and individual furnishings are outside the preview.
